hero.title: Everything your daily puja needs, in one place
hero.lede: Agarbatti, dhoop, camphor and samagri chosen for how they burn, smell and last. Packed with care and dispatched from {city}.

story.body: Sourced directly from verified makers across South India, priced with GST included and described honestly. A product joins the catalogue only when it earns its place.

pure.title: Nothing synthetic
pure.body: No charcoal base, no artificial perfume, no chemical dyes. Every ingredient is listed on the pack.

fresh.title: Small-batch & fresh
fresh.body: Made in small runs and dispatched within days of production — fragrance at its strongest.

chosen.title: Chosen by hand
chosen.body: A product joins the catalogue only after we burn, smell and use it ourselves. If it fades, it is out.

first.quote: The sambrani smells exactly like the one my mother used. I have ordered twice already — always fresh.
first.name: Meenakshi R.

second.quote: Packed with real care. The camphor arrived intact and burns clean, with no black residue at all.
second.name: Prakash V.

third.quote: Delivery to Bengaluru took three days. The rose attar is lovely — my whole puja room smells of it.
third.name: Lakshmi N.
